column1: # OWASP ZAP baseline scan rule configuration
# Start permissive (WARN) while the app is new; tighten to FAIL as you fix findings.
# Missing Anti-clickjacking Header — common on API-only routes, warn for now
# These are legitimate to fix — Next.js needs explicit header config for these
# Cookie without Secure/HttpOnly flag — relevant since Supabase sets auth cookies
# Server-side info leakage (e.g. framework version headers) — low severity, warn only
